name: GV/3-series guardian droid
description: GV/3-series guardian droids, also known as Guardian-class Droids and commonly referred to as Guardian droids, were droids that resembled canines. They were made by Cybot Galactica to act as security.

data.name: GV/3-series guardian droid
equipment: Grasper jaw with retractable blade incisors
Two visual and auditory sensors (Human range)
